issues.reason: The stop event has an object (`Theme` = the activity), so it is transitive and its subject stays `Agent` — "inanimacy alone never demotes a transitive subject", and the change-of-state test is explicitly "for intransitives" only; the instruction set's own "the ferry stop running" query confirms the shape with `(Agent $s $f)`.

`Experiencer` is defined as the subject of a stative predication (psych/perception state or predicate-adjective property state), and a device functioning is neither — the same worked example gives the running ferry `(Agent $e $f)`, and the intransitive-subject test's stated default when unclear is `Agent`.

new_gaps: eventive cessation ("stopped V-ing") does not say whether the ceased activity takes `(Ongoing …)`, although its inception mirror ("began to V") explicitly marks the `Theme` activity `Ongoing`
repair_summary: Changed `(Patient sk_stop_1 sk_adaptor_1)` to `(Agent sk_stop_1 sk_adaptor_1)` (transitive subject stays `Agent`); changed `(Experiencer sk_work_1 sk_adaptor_1)` to `(Agent sk_work_1 sk_adaptor_1)` (a functioning device is not a stative predication); renamed those two proof names to `e_stop_ag` / `e_work_ag` to match.
notes: Both fixes are role reassignments only — every other atom, truth value, symbol and the atom ordering are unchanged. The un-fused descriptive `old`, the surface-form `(Manner sk_stop_1 suddenly)` and the two `Past` atoms were already correct.
